reverse_string <- function(input_string) {
  string_length <- nchar(input_string)
  char_vector <- strsplit(input_string, split = "")[[1]]
  
  reversed_chars <- character(string_length)
  
  for (i in 1:string_length) {
    original_index <- string_length - i + 1
    reversed_chars[i] <- char_vector[original_index]
  }
  
  output_string <- paste(reversed_chars, collapse = "")
  
  return(output_string)
}

sum_even <- function(numbers) {
  even_numbers <- c()
  i <- 1
  while (i <= length(numbers)) {
    num <- numbers[i]
    if (num %% 2 == 0) {
      even_numbers <- c(even_numbers, num)
    }
    i <- i + 1
  }
  
  total_sum <- 0
  if (length(even_numbers) > 0) {
    total_sum <- sum(even_numbers)
  }
  
  return(total_sum)
}

count_chars <- function(input_string, char_to_count) {
  lower_string <- tolower(input_string)
  lower_char <- tolower(char_to_count)
  
  string_chars <- strsplit(lower_string, split = "")[[1]]
  
  count <- 0
  
  for (i in seq_along(string_chars)) {
    current_char <- string_chars[i]
    if (current_char == lower_char) {
      count <- count + 1
    }
  }
  
  final_count <- count

is_palindrome <- function(input_string) {

  normalized_string <- tolower(input_string)
  pattern_to_remove <- "[^a-z0-9]"
  clean_string <- gsub(pattern_to_remove, "", normalized_string)

  char_vector <- strsplit(clean_string, split = "")[[1]]
  reversed_vector <- rev(char_vector)

  reversed_string <- paste0(reversed_vector, collapse = "")

  are_equal <- (clean_string == reversed_string)

}

find_max <- function(vec) {
  if (length(vec) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  current_max <- vec[1]
  vec_len <- length(vec)
  i <- 2

  while (i <= vec_len) {
    element <- vec[i]
    if (element > current_max) {
      current_max <- element
    }
    i <- i + 1
  }

  final_max_val <- current_max
  return(final_max_val)
}

For example, `remove_duplicates(c(1, 2, 2, 3, 1))` should return `c(1, 2, 3)`, and `remove_duplicates(c('a', 'b', 'a', 'c'))` should return `c('a', 'b', 'c')`.

remove_duplicates <- function(input_vector) {
  unique_elements <- c()
  seen_elements <- c()
  
  for (element in input_vector) {
    is_new <- !(element %in% seen_elements)
    if (is_new) {
      unique_elements <- c(unique_elements, element)
      seen_elements <- c(seen_elements, element)
    }
  }
  
  return(unique_elements)
}

rectangle_area <- function(length_val, width_val) {
  # Input validation
  if (!is.numeric(length_val) || !is.numeric(width_val)) {
    stop("Both length and width must be numeric.")
  }

  if (length_val < 0 || width_val < 0) {
    warning_message <- "Length and width should be non-negative. Calculating with absolute values."
    warning(warning_message)
    length_val <- abs(length_val)
    width_val <- abs(width_val)
  }

  # Calculate the area
  area_result <- length_val * width_val

  # Return the calculated area
  return(area_result)
}

common_elements <- function(vec1_input, vec2_input) {
  unique_vec1 <- unique(vec1_input)
  unique_vec2 <- unique(vec2_input)
  
  common_values <- c()
  
  for (element in unique_vec1) {
    if (element %in% unique_vec2) {
      common_values <- c(common_values, element)
    }
  }
  
  final_result <- common_values
  return(final_result)

capitalize_words <- function(input_string) {
  words_list <- strsplit(input_string, "\\s+")[[1]]
  
  capitalized_words_list <- lapply(words_list, function(word) {
    if (nchar(word) == 0) {
      return("")

    first_char <- substr(word, 1, 1)
    rest_of_word <- substr(word, 2, nchar(word))

    lowercase_rest <- tolower(rest_of_word)
    
    combined_word <- paste0(capitalized_first, lowercase_rest)
    return(combined_word)
  })
  
  result_string <- paste(capitalized_words_list, collapse = " ")
  return(result_string)
}

calculate_sd <- function(x_vector) {
  n_elements <- length(x_vector)
  
  if (n_elements < 2) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  
  mean_val <- sum(x_vector) / n_elements
  
  differences_from_mean <- x_vector - mean_val
  
  squared_differences <- differences_from_mean^2

  variance_unbiased <- sum_squared_differences / (n_elements - 1)
  
  sd_result <- sqrt(variance_unbiased)
  
  return(sd_result)

roman_to_int <- function(roman_numeral) {
  roman_map <- c(I = 1, V = 5, X = 10)
  int_val <- 0
  n <- nchar(roman_numeral)
  i <- 1

  while (i <= n) {
    current_char <- substr(roman_numeral, i, i)
    current_val <- roman_map[[current_char]]

    if (i < n) {
      next_char <- substr(roman_numeral, i + 1, i + 1)
      next_val <- roman_map[[next_char]]

      if (current_val < next_val) {
        int_val <- int_val + (next_val - current_val)
        i <- i + 2
      } else {
        int_val <- int_val + current_val
        i <- i + 1
      }
    } else {
      int_val <- int_val + current_val
      i <- i + 1
    }
  }
  result <- int_val
  return(result)
}

  roman_map = c(I = 1, V = 5, X = 10)
  int_val = 0
  n = nchar(roman_numeral)
  i = 1

  while (i <= n) {
    current_char = substr(roman_numeral, i, i)
    current_val = roman_map[[current_char]]

    if (i < n) {
      next_char = substr(roman_numeral, i + 1, i + 1)
      next_val = roman_map[[next_char]]

      if (current_val < next_val) {
        int_val = int_val + (next_val - current_val)
        i = i + 2
      } else {
        int_val = int_val + current_val
        i = i + 1
      }
    } else {
      int_val = int_val + current_val
      i = i + 1
    }
  }
  result = int_val
  return(result)
}

convert_length <- function(value, from_unit, to_unit) {
  conversion_factors <- list(
    "m" = 1,
    "km" = 1000,
    "cm" = 0.01
  )

  if (!from_unit %in% names(conversion_factors) || !to_unit %in% names(conversion_factors)) {
    stop_message <- "Invalid unit specified. Supported units are 'm', 'km', 'cm'."
    stop(stop_message)
  }

  from_factor <- conversion_factors[[from_unit]]
  to_factor <- conversion_factors[[to_unit]]

  # Convert to base unit (meters)
  value_in_meters <- value * from_factor

  # Convert from base unit to target unit
  result <- value_in_meters / to_factor

  return(result)
}
